# Head commit is 40-char hex SHA

GitCollector.head_commit() must return a string of length 40 containing only hexadecimal characters in 0-9 and a-f.

Ensure the collector exposes the repository head as a canonical git SHA identifier for provenance and tracing.

**Anchored to:**

- `tests/test_git_collector.py` — `tests.test_git_collector.test_head_commit_is_a_sha`
